notes: Example configuration generated by the CraneCalc configurator; fictitious crane, supplier and owner data, to be replaced with project data. Scope: 5 simply supported 25-ft bays, W12X72 girders, two 2-ton pendant cranes, on existing column brackets by others; the rail, girders, ties to the column face, bearings and end stops. Existing building frames, column brackets, anchors and foundations are excluded. A direct flange saddle does not suit this rolled girder (the sized saddle leaves flange-tie-flange 1.05 for the estimated tie demands): the paired flat bars bolt to the tie-side bearing stiffener, cut as one plate with its gusset extension past the flange tip (no weld at the gusset), the full-depth stiffener pair carrying the tie force into the girder. Bumper overhang assumed 20 in (end-wheel centerline to the extended bumper face, a typical supplier proportion): the stop contact positions use it; confirm with the crane supplier.

aist.cycleSource: Fictitious example duty: 20,000 wheel-induced stress fluctuations in three duty bins (rated, half and light lifts), loaded and empty passes included. The bins are an assumed general-service proportion, not crane or owner data, so the fatigue checks govern by the all-cycle bound (the full fatigue load at every one of the 20,000 cycles); Miner's sum over the bins is listed for comparison until a sourced duty spectrum is entered.

fabrication.steel: Girder ASTM A992; plates, bars and stiffeners ASTM A572 Grade 50 unless noted.
fabrication.bolting: ASTM F3125 Grade A325, pretensioned, Class B faying surfaces, standard holes unless slots are detailed. Sliding-end bearing bolts and column-end tie bolts pretensioned against steel sleeves. Rail joints tight (gap 1/16 in max.) with the rail supplier's joint bars and bolts (deferred submittal), bolts pretensioned and re-tightened after 30 and 90 days of operation.
fabrication.welding: E70XX low-hydrogen electrodes per AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020, cyclically loaded provisions. Continuous fillets as dimensioned; no intermittent welds on cyclic load paths. Smooth starts and stops.
fabrication.inspection: Visual inspection of all welds; AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020 cyclically loaded acceptance criteria; magnetic particle testing of fillets at fatigue-sensitive attachments; 100% ultrasonic testing of CJP welds; bolt pretension verification per RCSC.
fabrication.erection: Set and level the bearings, install the end bearings and flange ties, then set the rails. Provide temporary restraint until the permanent ties are complete.
fabrication.railAlignment: Set the rails to the specified gauge, alignment and level tolerances and survey them after erection, before the load test.
